end.summary:
Ishaan practised classifying decimals and converting repeating decimals to fractions.
They identified repeating patterns and used 10x or 100x based on the repeating block.
They correctly simplified 36/99 to 4/11 and derived 27/99 for 0.272727….
They converted 0.777… to 7/9 using subtraction.
Ishaan continued to state that 0.999… is less than 1; this was not corrected by the end.
end.parentNote: Ishaan practised recognising repeating decimals and the place-value subtraction method for converting them to fractions. They correctly used two-digit shifting for 0.272727… and one-digit shifting for 0.777…, including the result 7/9. They mixed up the subtraction result for 0.1666… and continued to think 0.999… has a gap below 1; this was not corrected later in the lesson. At home, practise writing x, 10x or 100x, and subtracting the two equations for a few repeating decimals.
